Extract One
*You will hear an interview with someone who has started a magazine for children.*

items.q: What does Kate say about enthusiasm?
options: A) Children respond positively to it.
B) Children cannot maintain it for long time.
C) Children experience it more than adults.

items.q: Kate says that she learnt from her research that children …
options: A) don’t want to feel that they are being considered inferior.
B) don’t like texts that have too much serious content.
C) don’t know some words that she had expected them to know.

items.q: Why does Rachel include a commentary in the catalogue?

blocks.text: You will hear a part of a lecture. For each question, fill in the missing information in the numbered space. Write no more than ONE WORD for each answer.

blocks.title: MARS EXPLORATION
lines: ▪ A mission to Mars could take over a (30)__________ just to reach the planet.
▪ One major concern for astronauts is exposure to harmful (31)__________ in space.
▪ Developing the technology for Mars travel is incredibly (32)__________.
▪ Astronauts may struggle with feelings of (33)__________ due to long periods away from Earth.
▪ Some critics argue that space funding should be (34)__________ to fight problems on our own planet.
▪ Scientists worry that Martian soil might contain unidentified (35)__________ that could pose risks.
